Introduction. Deathsquitos are aggressive creatures found in Plains. They are, as their name suggests, enlarged mosquito-type bugs that give off a loud buzzing noise.

Sting. Lunges forward to stab the player with their proboscis (90 Pierce damage). This hits in a 1.6-meter 60-degree horizontal arc. It can use this attack every 10 seconds when 1.5 meters from a player.

Notes. • Despite their size, Deathsquitos are one of the most deadly creatures due to their relative speed and high pierce damage.
